description: Resolve DNS records for a host name. Returns A, AAAA, MX, TXT, NS, CNAME and SOA by default; pass 'types' to narrow. Read-only.

name.description: Host name to query, e.g. example.com

types.description: Optional record types to query (A, AAAA, MX, TXT, NS, CNAME, SOA, PTR, CAA). Omit for the common set.

name: dns_lookup
